g.title: OX171
g.text: OX-171 | Park mural foundation
PROPOSED SHARED BEHAVIOR BOARD — OWNER APPROVAL PENDING

g.title: cluster_37
g.text: OX-37 | Declare optional exact-data surface

g.title: cluster_42
g.text: OX-42 | Place the Park mural wall and anchor

g.title: cluster_85
g.text: OX-85 | Establish initial portrait camera and safe areas

g.title: start
g.text: BOUNDARY | First Park mural foundation
No selected-time reading is bound or painted in this group

g.title: prereq37
g.text: DONE INPUTS
OX-35 element geometry/anchors
OX-04 evidence and unknown-state rules

g.title: declare
g.text: PROPOSED CONTRACT
Park mural may declare one data-surface identity
with plane, anchor, reserved region, and one
canonical exact-binding reference

g.title: exit37
g.text: OX-37 EXIT
One wall surface can opt into one exact-value binding;
other worlds need no surface; mural rendering is not implemented.

g.title: exclude37
g.text: No data-surface requirement for First City/Open Landscape.
No drawing-time forecast conversion or weather inference.
Binding semantics remain owned by OX-12.

g.title: prereq42
g.text: DONE / IN-CYCLE INPUTS
OX-25 Park scaffold is DONE
OX-37 surface declaration precedes placement

g.title: exit37->prereq42
g.text: in-cycle dependency

g.title: place
g.text: PROPOSED SCENE OBJECT
Add the left-wall mural plane and declared anchor
Reserve a non-occluded data region

g.title: blank
g.text: Reserved region remains blank
No measured value, unit, source time,
unsupported state, or typography yet

g.title: exit42
g.text: OX-42 EXIT
Installed portrait evidence shows the mural plane
and readable reserved region; no exact reading claimed.

g.title: prereq85
g.text: DONE / IN-CYCLE INPUTS
OX-25 Park scaffold and OX-41 composition map
OX-42 mural plane precedes camera fit

g.title: exit42->prereq85
g.text: in-cycle dependency

g.title: camera
g.text: PROPOSED PORTRAIT CONTRACT
Record logical crop, viewport/insets, and safe areas
for the coarse Park scene and blank mural region

g.title: preserve
g.text: Keep central weather facts and timeline
visible and unobstructed; the Park stays recognizable

g.title: exit85
g.text: OX-85 EXIT
Installed Pixel 3 XL portrait evidence records the crop,
viewport/insets, clear central content, recognizable Park,
and reserved mural plane.

g.title: park_base
g.text: INHERITED OX-25/OX-41 CONSTRAINTS
Keep the coarse backdrop, path, and entrance.
Mural is a later landmark; its reference art does not
approve literal readings, weather, or finished details.

g.title: invariant
g.text: SHARED INVARIANTS
Exact selected-time authority remains unchanged.
Supported facts stay textual; missing/unsupported evidence is never zero or invented.
Decorative scene content cannot cover the central readout or timeline.

g.title: later
g.text: OUT OF SCOPE
OX-12/OX-12A exact binding and painted reading; final mural materials/typography;
OX-43 vegetation/benches; OX-44 shelter; weather renderer work; broad system acceptance.
